claim: The one-frame graphic hit is a defining anime action beat - a single drawing that violates the film's own rendering rules for a sixteenth of a second. Sketch_frame exposes the raw genga underneath; negative and silhouette_pop reduce the character to pure shape at the moment of contact.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: white flash frame, blown out white, high contrast
black flash frame, blacked out, high contrast
inverted colors, negative image, color inversion
rough sketch, genga, pencil lines, unfinished drawing
silhouette, solid black figure, flat color background

review.issue: The "none" clause "normal rendering, no impact effect" is prose plus a negation. "normal rendering" is not a tag and the negation is ignored, so the baseline panel is being perturbed for no reason.
